weakness_class: F115 Security controls bypass or absence
trigger: _create_access_token_dict derives the DatabaseStrategy session token from md5(user_id + current hour) instead of secrets.token_urlsafe()
exploit_path: attacker who knows a target user_id and the issuance hour computes md5('<user_id>-<unix_hour>') and presents it as a bearer token to impersonate the user with no credentials
notes: predictable/insufficiently-random session token (CWE-330/CWE-384); py_compile verified; secrets import removed as now-unused
